A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the synthesis of SHN in the region of Z = 119 is more favorable than in the region of the superheavy elements (SHE) with Z = 118, 120, and 122.
SHN with Z similar to 119 can be synthesized with relatively high cross sections in hot fusion reactions with Ti-50 projectiles and SHN with Z > or = 120 with Ti-50, Cr-54, and Fe-58 projectiles.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the synthesis of superheavies with Z = 112 and 114 is possible with a Ti-50 + Cm-244 and Ti-50+ Cf-249 system, respectively.
the synthesis of SHN with Z > 118 is feasible with Ti-50 and Fe-58 beams on trans-uranium (U, Pu, Cm, and Cf) targets.
the production of SHN with Z > 118 can be enhanced by choosing a suitable projectile-target combination.
